theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.wtraceW_ocneanu_zero_eq_molien {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) :
wtraceW q hq0 hq2 (ocneanuWeight q 0) = wtraceW q hq0 hq2 (molienWeight (q ^ 2))

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.eq_molien_of_zero {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (T : HeckeCoset.MarkovTraceFamily K q q⁻¹ 0) (n : ℕ) (x : Hecke K q q⁻¹ n) :
(T.tr n) x = (wtraceW q hq0 hq2 (molienWeight (q ^ 2)) n) x

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.molienMarkovTrace_symmetrising {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (m : ℕ) (p : HeckeCoset.cosetIndex m) :
(p = HeckeCoset.cosetOne m → (wtraceW q hq0 hq2 (molienWeight (q ^ 2)) m) (HeckeCoset.cosetFam m p) = 1) ∧ (p ≠ HeckeCoset.cosetOne m → (wtraceW q hq0 hq2 (molienWeight (q ^ 2)) m) (HeckeCoset.cosetFam m p) = 0)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.molienMarkovTrace_tr {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) :
(molienMarkovTrace q hq0 hq2).tr = wtraceW q hq0 hq2 (molienWeight (q ^ 2))

noncomputable def QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.molienMarkovTrace {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) :
HeckeCoset.MarkovTraceFamily K q q⁻¹ 0

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.markov_molienWeight {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) {m : ℕ} (y : Hecke K q q⁻¹ m) :
∑ L : { ρ : YoungDiagram // ρ.cells.card = m + 2 }, molienWeight (q ^ 2) ↑L * ((seminormalRep q hq hq2 (m + 1) ⋯) ((HeckeInclusion.heckeIncl K q q⁻¹ m) y) * genMat q (m + 1) ⋯ ⋯).trace = 0 * ∑ ν : { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = m + 1 }, molienWeight (q ^ 2) ↑ν * ((seminormalRep q hq hq2 m ⋯) y).trace

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.sum_molienWeight_mul_eq_zero {F : Type u_1} [Field F] (Q q : F) (hQ0 : Q ≠ 0) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hgen : ∀ (k : ℤ), k ≠ 0 → Q ^ k ≠ 1) {m : ℕ} (t : { ρ : YoungDiagram // ρ.cells.card = m + 2 } → F) (t' : { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = m + 1 } → F) (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ), r ≠ 0 → ∑ L : { ρ : YoungDiagram // ρ.cells.card = m + 2 }, wenzlWeight r Q ↑L * t L = Q ^ r / (q * levelBracket r Q) * ∑ ν : { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = m + 1 }, wenzlWeight r Q ↑ν * t' ν) :
∑ L : { ρ : YoungDiagram // ρ.cells.card = m + 2 }, molienWeight Q ↑L * t L = 0

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.sum_addable_molienWeight {F : Type u_1} [Field F] (Q : F) (hQ0 : Q ≠ 0) (hgen : ∀ (k : ℤ), k ≠ 0 → Q ^ k ≠ 1) (ν : YoungDiagram) :
∑ s : { s : ℕ × ℕ // Mathlib.IsAddableCell ν s }, molienWeight Q (Mathlib.addCellOrSelf ν ↑s) = molienWeight Q ν

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.sum_dim_molienWeight_eq_one {F : Type u_1} [Field F] (Q : F) (hQ0 : Q ≠ 0) (hgen : ∀ (k : ℤ), k ≠ 0 → Q ^ k ≠ 1) (n : ℕ) :
∑ ν : { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = n }, ↑(Mathlib.numStandardYoungTableaux ↑ν) * molienWeight Q ↑ν = 1

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.eval_zero_eq_of_eval_pow {F : Type u_1} [Field F] (Q : F) (hQ0 : Q ≠ 0) (hgen : ∀ (k : ℤ), k ≠ 0 → Q ^ k ≠ 1) (p₁ p₂ : Polynomial F) (h : ∀ (r : ℕ), r ≠ 0 → Polynomial.eval (Q ^ r) p₁ = Polynomial.eval (Q ^ r) p₂) :
Polynomial.eval 0 p₁ = Polynomial.eval 0 p₂

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.pow_succ_injective {F : Type u_1} [Field F] (Q : F) (hQ0 : Q ≠ 0) (hgen : ∀ (k : ℤ), k ≠ 0 → Q ^ k ≠ 1) :
Function.Injective fun (r : ℕ) => Q ^ (r + 1)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.eval_pow_wenzlPoly {F : Type u_1} [Field F] (Q : F) (hQ0 : Q ≠ 0) {r : ℕ} (hbr : levelBracket r Q ≠ 0) (μ : YoungDiagram) :
Polynomial.eval (Q ^ r) (wenzlPoly Q μ) = (1 - Q ^ r) ^ μ.cells.card * wenzlWeight r Q μ

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.eval_zero_wenzlPoly {F : Type u_1} [Field F] (Q : F) (μ : YoungDiagram) :
Polynomial.eval 0 (wenzlPoly Q μ) = molienWeight Q μ

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.eval_wenzlPoly {F : Type u_1} [Field F] (Q a : F) (μ : YoungDiagram) :
Polynomial.eval a (wenzlPoly Q μ) = Q ^ QBeta.WenzlWeight.nPart μ * ∏ x ∈ μ.cells, (1 - Q) / (1 - Q ^ QBeta.WenzlWeight.hook μ x) * (1 - Q ^ QBeta.WenzlWeight.content x * a)

noncomputable def QOU.SchurWeyl.wenzlPoly {F : Type u_1} [Field F] (Q : F) (μ : YoungDiagram) :
Polynomial F

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.ocneanuWeight_zero_eq_molienWeight {F : Type u_1} [Field F] (q : F) (μ : YoungDiagram) :
ocneanuWeight q 0 μ = molienWeight (q ^ 2) μ

noncomputable def QOU.SchurWeyl.molienWeight {F : Type u_1} [Field F] (Q : F) (μ : YoungDiagram) :
F
